title: Agent Passport rule pack — B2B payment initiation, model register (prototype)

policy.ceilings_note: Policy ceilings set by the authority when it approves a model. Every mandate on that model must stay within them; the containment check runs when the customer signs.

pattern_threshold.note: same rule refused this many times within the window on one passport raises a supervisor alert

chain_rules.title: Root mandate scope is well formed
Delegation is a subset of the root mandate
chain_rules.source: Delegation signed by the orchestrator key in agent_identity.cnf; beneficiaries, ceiling, actions, validity ⊆ root

chain_rules.title: Action lies inside the narrowest scope
chain_rules.source: Instruction signed by the delegated execution key named in the delegation

runtime_rules.title: Passport ACTIVE and the underlying model approval APPROVED and unexpired (registry lookup)
runtime_rules.source: Authority registries: passports and approved models (real-time lookup); model revocation cascades

runtime_rules.title: Agent identity signature genuine (customer organisation key) and references the approved model
Instruction signed by the agent key inside agent_identity
Mandate signed by the customer's authorising officer and unexpired
Action permitted and payee account on the customer-signed allowlist
Amount plus 30-day total for this payee account within the monthly limit
runtime_rules.source: Mandate monthly_limit_per_account; bank-held ledger (limit in the mandate, total in the bank)

runtime_rules.title: Supervisor condition: amount above human_confirm_above is held for a named human
runtime_rules.source: Assurance condition set by the authority officer

model_rules.title: Company number resolves to the registrant and is active
Model documentation declared: name, pinned version, training type
model_rules.source: EU AI Act-style provider documentation (prototype condition)

model_rules.title: Benchmarks declared and attributed (provider-attested, test set named)
Model publisher signature verifies over the documentation
